rationale: PULLED BACK from initial 'publish' pass (Session 18): this destination (doppiat.com, a perfume/cosmetics e-commerce brand catalog) has no plausible connection to this portal's mandate (District Rural Development Agency, Tinsukia — verified official government portal). ~234 distinct doppiat.com/brand-a-z/*.html links from this single portal is a strong signal of spam-link injection or domain/site compromise, not ordinary link rot. Publishing these as routine 'broken official link' findings would understate what's actually going on and miss a more serious, differently-shaped story. Needs a human decision on how (or whether) to characterize this — possibly outside the existing finding taxonomy — before publication; see also whether the portal should be reported to the department. Not published pending that call.
